k: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of the officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.

They will be exposed to the sun and moon, and to all the host of heaven which they have loved, served, followed, consulted, and worshiped. Their bones will not be gathered up or buried, but will become like dung lying on the ground.
And wherever I have banished them, the remnant of this evil family will choose death over life,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
So you are to tell them this is what the LORD says:
“Do men fall and not get up again?
Does one turn away and not return?
Why then have these people turned away?
Why does Jerusalem always turn away?
they do not speak what is right.
No one repents of his wickedness,
Everyone has pursued his own course
like a horse charging into battle.
Even the stork in the sky
The turtledove, the swift, and the thrush
but My people do not know
How can you say, ‘We are wise,
and the Law of the LORD is with us,’
when in fact the lying pen of the scribes
The wise will be put to shame;
they will be dismayed and trapped.
Since they have rejected the word of the LORD,
what wisdom do they really have?
Therefore I will give their wives to other men
and their fields to new owners.
For from the least of them to the greatest,
They dress the wound of the daughter of My people
when there is no peace at all.
Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed?
No, they have no shame at all;
they do not even know how to blush.
So they will fall among the fallen;
when I punish them, they will collapse,
I will take away their harvest,
There will be no grapes on the vine,
and even the leaf will wither.
Whatever I have given them will be lost to them.”

let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there,
